name: ANSI/IEEE Dy5 transformer connection reference form
summary: IEEE-library form of dy5 transformer connection reference: this reference identifies the publisher's Dy5 transformer connection form with delta/star winding topology.
description: This reference locates dy5 transformer connection reference in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented 3 phase transformers family. Dy5 combines an HV-side delta winding designation with an LV-side star designation and clock group 5. The letters describe connection topology; the final number identifies the phase relationship recorded with the transformer connection diagram. It is different from the voltage ratio or the number of terminals. The public library uses HXF1T21 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace each winding, supply and accessible neutral through the complete machine or transformer connection diagram. Keep the phase arrangement, terminal labels and any clock notation attached to the device; neither the convention label nor this educational outline supplies its ratings.

A drafter should preserve the full Dy5 designation across the SLD, transformer schedule and protection references. Two devices with the same winding letters but a different clock number are not the same connection reference. Check the selected transformer terminal diagram and the protection application documentation; the concept preview does not specify polarity tests, parallel-operation suitability or relay settings. Preserve the full group notation and verify the terminal/phase relationship in the selected transformer diagram. The clock-group suffix is different from a voltage ratio, power rating or physical terminal number. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
